description: This file defines the NullLogger class in the PSR Log namespace, which serves as a no-operation implementation of a logger that can be used to avoid conditional logging calls. It extends the AbstractLogger class and provides a log method that does nothing.

classes.name: NullLogger
classes.description: A logger implementation that does nothing, useful as a default or placeholder.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Implements the LoggerInterface log method, but performs no action.
